_comment: All AI/ML flags default OFF. Existing bot behavior is preserved until each flag is enabled.

ai_mode._comment: Master switch. false = full legacy behavior. true = AI-assisted mode.

m1_setup_model._comment: M1: scales lot between min_lot_fraction*base and 1.0*base. Never zeros a trade.

m2_excursion_model._comment: M2: sets dynamic TP levels from predicted MFE quantiles.

m3_trade_manager._comment: rules | model. Start with rules, upgrade to model after backtest.

risk_guard._comment: Risk Guard is always ON. Deterministic, never an ML model.
risk_guard._comment2: daily_loss_cap_abs=0 means use pct. Set abs to override with a fixed $ amount.
risk_guard._comment3: cooldown_after_daily_cap_bars=0 means halt for rest of day.
risk_guard._comment4: If spread > this fraction of ATR, log warning but do NOT skip setup (per plan).

data._comment: NY 4:59 PM EST = 21:59 UTC (non-DST). Adjust for DST as needed.
